name: P07 #1 — FACE (2): level camera, one grown face at a time.

steps.note: F0. Keep the camera LEVEL. placeCamera puts it dist*sin(9deg) ABOVE the target and looks down a fixed 9deg, so raising cameraAim lifts the camera with the target and only steepens the view onto the hat. Aiming LOW (0.52 = the demo default) puts it at eye height, where a wide brim is seen edge-on and the face is clear.
F1. The farmer. His 0.35 u brim is 1.7x his 0.208 head radius, so he needs the level camera more than anyone: at aim 0.82 the camera sits 0.47 above his eye and looks down onto the brim.
F2. The baker — the first villager face off the shared kit (was 'arc' eyes, no sclera).
F3. Barty, the gap's clearest doll: was 39.9% head share on a 1.23 u body, now 34.8% on 1.35 u.
F4. Halvard, the reference for what 'already right' looks like on this kit.
